twitter_title: That "Stacking Waves" technique is broken! 🤯 The Immortals don't even get it.
twitter_description: The Immortal Fortunes Assembly just got real. The Slovenly True Immortal pulls out a secret technique, while Cangwu Jiu awakens a new Dao from the sidelines!

lore_anchors.definition: A profoundly mysterious combat technique derived from the Lord Darkmarsh Divine Ability. It allows the user to endlessly stack defensive and offensive power in waves, making each subsequent attack stronger than the last until the opponent is overwhelmed.

surfaces: Grand Dao of Life and Death
lore_anchors.definition: An extremely profound and powerful Grand Dao governing the transition between life and death. It grants both potent regenerative abilities and lethal attack power, making it harder to master than the Dao of the Sword.
A mysterious, dirty girl with immense power and freakish durability. She treats combat as a game and speaks with blunt pragmatism, possessing a Dao-heart tempered by failure.
A powerful entrant in the Immortal Fortunes Assembly. He gains a major power-up by suddenly comprehending a complete Dao (the Dao of the Wind) from watching a battle, climbing the rankings.
A supreme Daofather of the Three Realms, the master of the Slovenly True Immortal. His divine ability is the source of the "Stacking Waves" technique.
The highest level of immortal cultivators discussed in this chapter. They are able to perceive the deeper principles of techniques like "Stacking Waves" even if they can't replicate them.
